slides.slide_title: Introduce three-letter clusters: str spr scr spl thr
slides.teacher_cue: Three-letter clusters — three consonants before the vowel. str (strip, strong, street), spr (spring, spray, spread), scr (scream, screen, scratch), spl (splash, split, splint), thr (three, throb, throw). All three consonants must be produced without any vowel between them. These are the most demanding clusters in English.
slides.expected_response: Students produce all five three-letter clusters without any vowel insertion.
slides.correction_move: Drill each cluster: str-str-str, spr-spr-spr, scr-scr-scr, spl-spl-spl, thr-thr-thr. Confirm all three consonants are present before moving to words.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel insertion at any position — uh-strip, suh-pring. All three consonants must connect seamlessly.

slides.teacher_cue: Say strip — a narrow piece. str cluster. All three sounds before the vowel. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say strip orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model strip orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for str cluster — no vowel between s, t, and r.

slides.teacher_cue: Say spring — the season; also to jump. spr cluster AND ng coda. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say spring orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model spring orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for spr onset — all three consonants — and /ŋ/ at end.

slides.teacher_cue: Say scream — to shout loudly. scr cluster, ea vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say scream orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model scream orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for scr onset — three consonants — and long /iː/ in ea.

slides.teacher_cue: Mime splashing water. spl cluster AND sh coda. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say splash orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model splash orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for spl onset — three consonants — and /ʃ/ at end.

slides.teacher_cue: Hold up three fingers. Say three — thr cluster, ee vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say three orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model three orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /θ/ in thr — voiceless th — and no vowel between /θ/ and /r/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say street — a road in a town. str cluster, ee vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say street orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model street orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for str onset and long /iː/ in ee.
